name: Lagrangian Per-Bucket Feature Representation
definition: A feature representation used at deeper levels (l >= L - L_tilde) of a hierarchical hash grid where features are not stored as static vectors in buckets but are instead computed as a weighted sum of isotropic Gaussians centered at learnable means, allowing for continuous, position-dependent feature retrieval.
summary: Lagrangian Per-Bucket Feature Representation computes features as a weighted sum of Gaussians, enabling continuous, position-dependent retrieval that distinguishes it from static Eulerian lookups.
